entities.name: Galileo Galilei
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Italian astronomer, physicist, and polymath (1564–1642) called the "father of modern science." His telescopic observations confirmed heliocentrism, and his experimental approach to physics laid groundwork for Newton. Tried by the Inquisition for heresy in 1633.
